expected_assessment: Both reported problems are plausible from the code: cancel_async only settles on CANCELLED/FAILED, so a ticket that reaches Matched first leaves the cancel pending; and the status-change FAILED path synthesizes E_FAIL instead of the native HRESULT.

evidence.why: TicketStatusChanged builds the FAILED result with E_FAIL, losing the native HRESULT.
TicketCompleted settles the pending cancel only for CANCELLED/FAILED; a Matched completion leaves it pending.
Terminal tickets are destroyed after the batch, so the pending cancel can never settle later.
